column1: # HOSE spherical environments · median · ReShiki v1
# CDCl3; recorded temperature 273–323 K, pooled without temperature/concentration correction

# Connectivity-only 2D environments do not distinguish E/Z or relative configurations, stereoisomers, or resolve diastereotopic H. Multiple attached H are an unresolved group median, not an assigned peak. Exchangeable H, charged/radical structures, metals and non-default isotope labels are unsupported. Reference spread is descriptive and is not a calibrated confidence interval.
